_meta.purpose: Line-item product catalogue. Drives random line-item selection in src/generators/orders.js and the printed item rows + HSN-wise tax summary in src/templates/*.js. Adding a product here is sufficient to surface it on generated PO/invoice PDFs; no template changes are required.

fields.code: stable item code (kebab/sku style). Treat as load-bearing — used in filenames is NOT done, but stable across runs for reproducibility.
fields.description: display description as printed in the item row. May be deliberately long for some entries to stress column wrapping.
fields.hsn: HSN/SAC code printed per line and grouped in the tax summary. India prints HSN on B2B invoices above turnover thresholds.
fields.unit: unit of measure printed in the Qty/UOM column. One of Nos | Kg | Box | Ltr | Set | Mtr | Pkt.
fields.priceMin: inclusive lower bound for the per-unit price sample (INR, pre-tax).
fields.priceMax: inclusive upper bound for the per-unit price sample (INR, pre-tax).
fields.gstSlab: applicable GST rate percentage. One of 0 | 5 | 12 | 18 | 28. Split evenly into CGST+SGST for intra-state or applied wholly as IGST for inter-state.

notes.gst_slabs: Slabs reflect common Indian GST categories: 0% (unprocessed staples), 5% (essentials), 12% (processed goods), 18% (most industrial goods/services), 28% (luxury/sin). Assignments here are illustrative, not authoritative tax advice.
notes.hsn_provenance: HSN codes are plausible 4-8 digit values for the product family but are synthetic; do not treat as a real classification.
